column1: # workflow-file<TAB>job-name: additional exact workflow basenames and job names
# required by the release gate. Blank lines and comments are ignored.
# The per-plugin job in plugins-ci.yml is implicit. The marketplace's own validation
# (manifest integrity, the release script suites, policy) must be green at the release
# commit before a draft is staged, so its always-run job is required here; the
# variable-gated pinned-sources job may be skipped and is not. Append the staging
# repository's CI line (ci.yml, setup, hooks, suites, secrets) when that workflow lands.
